description: Add database schema fields to support remaining demand tracking: total_allocated, total_dispatched, total_received columns in requests table, update status progression to include 'Partially Fulfilled', and modify finalize_request() to handle partial allocations correctly
steps: 1. Update SCHEMA in db.py to add three new INTEGER columns to requests table: total_allocated (tracks sum of all allocations over time), total_dispatched (tracks sum of dispatched deliveries), total_received (tracks sum of confirmed deliveries). All default to 0. Position them after allocated_qty column.
2. Add computed remaining_demand logic at query time using max(0, quantity - total_received) in SQL queries. Do NOT add as a stored column - calculate it in SELECT statements where needed.

3. Update status progression: keep existing statuses (Pending, Approved, Partially Approved, Rejected, Fulfilled) and ensure 'Partially Fulfilled' is a valid status for requests that received some deliveries but have remaining demand.

4. Modify finalize_request() in app.py to update total_allocated when creating a delivery (add the allocated qty to existing total_allocated). Keep allocated_qty as-is for backwards compatibility (stores the most recent allocation amount).

5. Update the advance_delivery() function in app.py: when delivery status becomes 'Delivered', increment total_received by delivery quantity and update request status to 'Partially Fulfilled' if remaining demand > 0, or 'Fulfilled' if remaining demand = 0.
6. Test by deleting reliefgrid.db, running python app.py, logging in as admin, and verifying schema with: sqlite3 reliefgrid.db '.schema requests' - confirm new columns exist.
acceptance_criteria: requests table has total_allocated, total_dispatched, total_received columns (all INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
finalize_request() increments total_allocated when creating deliveries
advance_delivery() updates total_received and sets status to 'Partially Fulfilled' or 'Fulfilled' based on remaining demand
Demo seed data loads successfully without errors
Existing allocation and delivery flows work without breaking
verification: Delete reliefgrid.db, run python app.py, and verify it starts without errors
Use sqlite3 reliefgrid.db '.schema requests' to confirm new columns exist
Login as admin (admin@reliefgrid.org/admin123), navigate to /admin/allocations, apply an allocation, advance a delivery to 'Delivered', and verify the request shows appropriate status
